scripts.dev:services: yarn workspace @tms/contracts build && concurrently --kill-others --names web,api "yarn dev:web" "yarn dev:api"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @tms/contracts build && yarn workspace @tms/api build && yarn workspace @tms/web build
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @tms/contracts build && tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @tms/api typecheck && yarn workspace @tms/web typecheck
scripts.test: yarn test:unit && yarn test:tooling && yarn test:integration && yarn test:e2e
scripts.demo:e2e: yarn demo:e2e:hr && yarn demo:e2e:leave && yarn demo:e2e:tasks
scripts.demo:e2e:hr: yarn e2e:db:reset && PLAYWRIGHT_DEMO=1 playwright test tests/e2e/demo.spec.ts --headed --project=chromium
scripts.demo:e2e:leave: yarn e2e:db:reset && PLAYWRIGHT_DEMO=1 playwright test tests/e2e/hr.spec.ts --headed --project=chromium --grep 'all five roles file leave'
scripts.demo:e2e:tasks: yarn e2e:db:reset && PLAYWRIGHT_DEMO=1 playwright test tests/e2e/tasks.spec.ts --headed --project=chromium
scripts.test:integration: yarn workspace @tms/contracts build && yarn workspace @tms/api test:integration
